parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query available region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The Nth instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to `instance`.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The Nth tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. This parameter cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. This parameter can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
